messages:
tariq: quick follow-up from the PM: recurring autoscale churn + low headroom. need clear owners for quota requests, emergency scheduler knobs, and a compact burst policy. proposing a single tracker + weekly 20m sync.

maya: i'll own the emergency scheduler knobs. plan: push conservative defaults in 3 business days, run smoke perf tests, then iterate. example emergency changes i'll test: 

```yaml
# emergency knobs
max_batch_tokens: 1024  # current 2048
prefer_smaller_batches: true
preemption_threshold: 0.3
```

anita: i'll take quota/vendor petitions. opening cloud/vendor tickets today and will note any minimum-commit asks. target initial replies in 48-72h, will flag finance if spend approvals needed.

sam: i'll draft the burst-buffer policy (reserve small burst pool + automated pre-warm). propose default burst = 6% fleet or 8 GPUs min/region. draft by +5d, include automation hooks.

leo: i can run the synthetic surges and validate canary steps. request 6 ephemeral GPUs for 36-48h next week.

opsbot: created task REM-BURST-9001 and scheduled "GPU Burst & Knobs sync" (Tues 09:30 PT). subtasks assigned to owners.

metrics-bot: snapshot: peak GPU util 99.1%, autoscale churn detected, free headroom dipped to 3% for 2.5h. saved traces to s3://incidents/gpu/2118887777/snapshot.json

```
Action checklist (confirm):
- QUOTA PETITIONS: owner=anita, due=+3d
- EMERGENCY SCHEDULER KNOBS: owner=maya, due=+3d
- BURST-BUFFER POLICY: owner=sam, due=+5d
- SURGE VALIDATION: owner=leo, due=+7d
- DASHBOARDS & ALERTING: owner=tariq, due=+2d
```

tariq: i'll create the tracker and invite owners. please update with blockers and windows for tests. first sync next Tue to review smoke results and vendor replies.

maya: ack, will post config diffs and perf baseline by EOD +3.

anita: opening tickets now, will paste links into tracker.

sam: will include rollout + rollback snippets in the draft runbook.

metrics-bot: 72h projection: 4-7% headroom depending on weekday traffic. recommend pre-warm before known peaks.

tariq: thanks everyone. if approvals or perms block you ping me here. :thumbsup:
